{{Quote|'The ag-producers of the Abrion have lived for decades with few options and limited control of the goods we provide. Now, though, we've found appreciative markets without the restrictive bureaucracy of the Republic,' explained Senator Esu Rotsino (Abrion Major) as she tendered her Articles of Secession in today's Senate session.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Abrion Major''' was an astronomical object<ref name="HNN" /> located in the [[Abrion Major system/Legends|Abrion Major system]], a part of the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Abrion Major served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Abrion [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="CSWE Abrion">{{CSWECite|I|7|Abrion sector}}</ref> and the latter was represented in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Esu Rotsino/Legends|Esu Rotsino]], who hailed from the sector.<ref name="CSWE Esu" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_1.html|Abrion Sector Secedes; Separatists Get Agri-Worlds}} is set on the date 13:4:18, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Rotsino tendered her<ref name="HNN" /> sector's<ref name="CSWE Esu" /> [[Articles of Secession/Legends|Articles of Secession]] in that [[Standard day/Legends|day's]] Senate session, thereby withdrawing the Abrion sector, which contained more than 200 [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]], from the Republic and entering it into the fold of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Later on the same date, Rotsino's actions and her comments on the matter were reported on in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abrion Major was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #52]], an issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|representation]] of the [[in-universe]] HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the HoloNet News website on [[April 18]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN52 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072939/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-11#post-6493893}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Abrion Major [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Abrion Major itself, in grid square S-15.<ref name="TEA" />
